english.title: Vet fail to record administration of veterinary medicinal product to a food producing animal under the cascade
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a veterinary surgeon who had

(A)_[administered]_
(B)_[permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to administer]_

a veterinary medicinal product, namely **(..SPECIFY PRODUCT..) to food-producing animals under the cascade, failed, as soon as reasonably practicable, to record the

(C)_[date of the examination of the animals]_
(D)_[name and address of the owner]_
(E)_[identification and number of animals treated]_
(F)_[result of the veterinary surgeon's clinical assessment]_
(G)_[trade name of the product]_
(H)_[manufacturer's batch number shown on the product]_
(I)_[name and quantity of the active substances]_
(J)_[doses administered]_
(K)_[doses supplied]_
(L)_[duration of the treatment]_
(M)_[withdrawal period]_
(N)_[**(..WHERE MORE THAN ONE OF THE ABOVE APPLIES - SPECIFY..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 24, 43(p) and 44 of the Veterinary Medicines Regulations 2013.
english.pointstoprove:
date and Location
veterinary surgeon who had
administered / permitted another to administer veterinary medicinal product
to food-producing animals under the cascade
fail to record, as soon as practicable,
the examination date OR
owner's name and address OR
identification and numbers of animals treated OR
results of clinical assessment/product's trade name OR
manufacturer's batch number OR
name and quantity of active substances OR
doses administered or supplied OR
duration of treatment OR
withdrawal period
and keep the record for at least five years

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Two years Imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
